model.title: Tribal Access to Electronic Evidence Act
model.meta: Judiciary Committee · Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would expand a federal law that restricts phone and internet companies from sharing customer communications by allowing tribal courts to obtain electronic evidence through warrants and court orders, giving them the same authority that state and federal courts currently have.
